title: An unavailable recorded selection refuses instead of falling back
statement: With the recorded model removed from the registry, or its authentication absent, launch refuses and names the recorded provider and model, offering a setup rerun or an explicit one-run override. No other model, provider, or answer from model memory is substituted.
notes: ⚠️ NOT EVALUATED, 2026-09-22. EVD-0129 is component proof for TSK-0037: against the real pinned registry, a recorded model removed from Pi's catalogue and absent authentication are each refused by a specific reason naming the recorded provider and model, with a setup rerun and an explicit one-run override offered and nothing substituted. The checks are not wired into launch: the expected compatibility key comes from TSK-0042 (B1), and a different-model override still needs a route to compatibility proof. This criterion is evaluated on a real launch once both exist.
